name: announcement-bar
title: Announcement Bar
description: A slim full-width bar for the top of a site with an optional badge, a message, a link and a dismiss button that can remember the dismissal.
usage:
<AnnouncementBar id="directory-v2">
  <AnnouncementBarBadge>New</AnnouncementBarBadge>
  <AnnouncementBarMessage>The directory now lists guestbooks.</AnnouncementBarMessage>
  <AnnouncementBarLink href="/changelog">Read more</AnnouncementBarLink>
</AnnouncementBar>
notes: Give the bar an id to remember a dismissal in localStorage; change the id for the next announcement. Without an id it only hides until the page reloads. resetAnnouncementBar(id) forgets a dismissal.
Variants: default (card), primary (orange) and subtle. The bar is a labelled region and the dismiss button has an accessible name.
